dataset_source.title: Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds
dataset_source.attribution: Source data: Tiago F. T. Cerqueira, Antonio Sanna and Miguel A. L. Marques, Sampling the materials space for conventional superconducting compounds, Materials Cloud 2023.163 v1, DOI 10.24435/materialscloud:qv-bq, CC BY 4.0. This catalogue is a derived projection with additional source-state screening commentary.

scope: Previously private source-model screening is now published as unscored source-computed material-design hypotheses. Historical private-screening wording is retained as context. These predictions are new to this reviewed catalogue only; experimental confirmation, worldwide first discovery, formal RPS and human scientific review are not claimed.
source_tc_scope: Source isotropic Eliashberg Tc in K at mu*=0.1 is a model result, not experimental Tc. It is a separate source product and is not associated with an individual Gaussian width or a numerical uncertainty interval.
pairing_response_scope: Retained ten-width lambda contrasts and independent source Tc products support bounded source-model comparisons. Chemical, mass, volume, sampling, spin and SOC effects can co-change; no universal causal or error-bound interpretation is assigned.
risk_tag_scope: Attention labels support browsing. Element labels are not measured magnetic ground states, rejection criteria or calibrated potential scores; no label does not mean no risk.

candidate.support_meaning: Preliminary screened support within the stated source model. This ordinal level is not a probability, formal RPS score or human scientific review.
candidate.risk_summary: Small source Eli Tc gain12.871 versus12.235K; all ten lambda contrasts positive but q3x3x5 versus4^3. Coarse/fine phase-energy preference flips at sub-meV fine scale; assess as near-degenerate phase response, not global ground state. Evaluated risks define a falsifiable bounded hypothesis, not an established bulk ground state or experimental coherence proof.
candidate.ambient_scope: Source nearambient fullstress/pressure and coarse-relaxed geometry, positive raw-Gamma optical compression beyond printing bounds, and no negative printed finite-path values support preliminary local feasibility only within the declared source approximation. WholeBZ/global hull/synthesis remain unknown.
candidate.route_response: Unique Nb periodic distance3.28156452 versus4.63614381A, while volumes differ only0.02134%; this is a colored ordering contrast, not a basis alias. Computed source EPC response is associated with construction; pure geometry-only causality and converged numerical uplift are unproved.
candidate.next_action: Match reciprocal-grid density/code and test whether the phase/EPC ordering survives; retain all ten source sigma points and competing phase.

seven_criteria.identity: Exact reduced composition and non-alias decorated ordered network linked to canonical SCF input and source PH/Gamma/model evidence; source positions bind Gamma within printing/operational tolerances. Nb same-species permutation and Zr scalar parity reflection are explicit. Experimental phase/state remains unknown.
seven_criteria.quantitative_route_response: Unique Nb periodic distance3.28156452 versus4.63614381A, while volumes differ only0.02134%; this is a colored ordering contrast, not a basis alias. Computed source EPC response is associated with construction; pure geometry-only causality and converged numerical uplift are unproved.
seven_criteria.pairing_relevance: Direct source lambda at ten common printed width tokens and independently retained mu*=0.1 Eliashberg Tc rows provide state-specific pairing relevance. Width units and Tc-to-width link remain unknown; no parent-property transfer or300K claim.
seven_criteria.ambient_feasibility: Source nearambient fullstress/pressure and coarse-relaxed geometry, positive raw-Gamma optical compression beyond printing bounds, and no negative printed finite-path values support preliminary local feasibility only within the declared source approximation. WholeBZ/global hull/synthesis remain unknown.
seven_criteria.competition_and_coherence: Small source Eli Tc gain12.871 versus12.235K; all ten lambda contrasts positive but q3x3x5 versus4^3. Coarse/fine phase-energy preference flips at sub-meV fine scale; assess as near-degenerate phase response, not global ground state. Evaluated risks define a falsifiable bounded hypothesis, not an established bulk ground state or experimental coherence proof.
seven_criteria.novelty: Primary Nb-rich Nb-Ta superconducting alloys and published theoretical source states are known; no exact ordered25Nb75Ta experimental benchmark identified by the bounded primary query. Default one exact-composition group, with all source/control variants underneath.
seven_criteria.decision: Match reciprocal-grid density/code and test whether the phase/EPC ordering survives; retain all ten source sigma points and competing phase. All seven minima support grade3 preliminary source-model screening; retained model-dependent uncertainty prevents grade4/formal publication.
